title: Add collection assignment to NFT upload form and reduce Mint button size

requirements.text: In the NFT upload/mint form (Upload page and/or MintNFTModal), add a collection selector field that allows the user to assign the NFT to an existing collection at the time of creation. The selector should fetch available collections and let the user pick one before submitting.

quotes: ich kann keine möglichkeit, das NFT eine Kollektion zuzuordnen finden

acceptanceCriteria: A collection dropdown/selector is visible in the NFT upload form
The dropdown is populated with collections fetched from the backend
The selected collection is passed along when creating/minting the NFT
If no collection is selected, the field is either optional or shows a clear placeholder

requirements.text: Reduce the visual size of the Mint button in the NFT upload form and/or MintNFTModal so it is proportionate to the other form controls rather than oversized.

quotes: Der Mint Buttom muß auch nicht so riesig sein

acceptanceCriteria: The Mint button is no longer visually dominant compared to other form elements
The button size is consistent with the general button style used elsewhere in the app

constraints: Do not add or modify any credit/billing/payment logic
nonGoals: Adding new backend endpoints for collection assignment (use existing ones)
Changing the overall page layout beyond the form adjustments
